4,510 likes, 69 comments - tanyakhanijow on October 7, 2026: "Finally, going away without constantly worrying about home is possible!

With @native.urbancompany Lock Ultra, I can give people access to my home remotely.
I can also see who’s at the door and even talk to them through the lock, all from wherever I am.

And coming back home is even easier with Face Unlock. No keys, no hiding them under the doormat, no “wait, where did I keep them?”
Just walk up and the door opens.

Basically, we can be away from home while our digital doorman handles the things back home.

Check out Native Lock Ultra by Urban Company and make your front door smarter.

#ad #Native #YearsAhead".
